text:
Alex K: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — multi-vendor outage (cloud auth + model-registry) yesterday. I pushed an action tracker and flagged the high-priority remediations. Please claim ownership and confirm ETAs: https://tracker.redwood/actions/INC-827

Maria P: grabbing model-registry fallback/cache work. will draft a local read-through cache prototype today. ETA: 2026-02-05.

Sandeep R: i'll take auth token retry/backoff + cloud IAM retry config. plan: implement jittered exponential backoff, add circuit-breaker for downstream auth, and tune retry budgets. target: 2026-02-07.

Jordan: i can run a focused chaos drill once we have fallbacks wired. also want to test routing policies to fallback model-variants in the dedicated pool. schedule for 2026-02-12.

Lisa S: security note — any local cache for model-registry needs explicit encryption + ACLs and an update to the runbook and KMS rotation cadence. assigning to me to own runbook updates. ETA: 2026-01-31.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-827 follow-ups created: ACTION-8271, ACTION-8272, ACTION-8273, ACTION-8274. Reminder: owners must update status in tracker within 48h.

Alex K: thanks — a few clarifications and pattern items observed during postmortem:
- recurrence: token-throttle events spike on midnight credential refresh windows, and when model-registry experiences transient 5xx we see cascading retries into auth.
- quick mitigations: add short-lived local cache + conservative retry budgets, and add an alert for auth retry rate > 50/min.

Maria P: note on cache: we'll use a bounded LRU with TTL=30s for non-sensitive model metadata, and fallback to a pinned snapshot for critical configs. i'll add a small integration test to failover to snapshot when registry 5xx occurs.

Sandeep R: auth retry config snippet i'll propose (will open PR):
```
# auth client config
retry_policy: exponential
initial_backoff_ms: 100
max_backoff_ms: 5000
max_retries: 4
jitter: true
circuit_breaker: failure_threshold=10, window=60s
```
This should stop token storms and give us a measurable alert signal.

Jordan: can we add a routing policy that prefers local-cache-aware nodes and falls back to cross-region only after 200ms? want to avoid cross-region thrash.

Alex K: yes — add policy to ACTION-8275 in the tracker. also: ask cloud provider for SLA confirmation on IAM throttling limits. Maria, Sandeep — pls include vendor contact and ticket ID in the tracker.

Lisa S: i'll coordinate vendor escalation for auth (we have a support channel). also want a pre-commit checklist for any cache that touches model artifacts.

Sandeep R: putting vendor contact in tracker: CLOUD-SUPPORT-5421. i'll follow up and paste responses.

Maria P: added ACTION-8272 details and initial PR link in tracker.

Alex K: operational notes for owners:
- mark the action with status: in_progress / blocked / done
- add estimated hours and weekly check-ins if > 1 week ETA
- rotate primary/secondary owners for 2-week coverage (so we don't accumulate single-owner blockers)

Jordan: suggestion — create a monthly "vendor-dep resilience" checkpoint and add a recurring incident pattern review to the incident cadence. will PR a proposal to the ops-docs.

Lisa S: +1. also propose we add a simple metric: auth_retry_ratio_by_window and a threshold that routes alerts to vendor/resilience channel.

Alex K: final asks: owners confirm by EOD, update the tracker with concrete ETAs and PR links, and label any action that requires cross-team review with "requires-ops-review". i'll consolidate and run a 15m sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Sandeep R: confirmed, i'll update tracker now. :thumbsup:

Maria P: confirmed, PR draft coming in ~2h.

Jordan: confirmed for chaos drill scheduling.

Lisa S: confirmed runbook/KMS updates owned.

Alex K: closing loop here — i'll post a short note in the all-hands summary after the sync. thanks everyone. :heart:
